headline: Airport Director to update committee on Manchester-Boston Regional Airport finances, operations, and capital projects.
summary: Airport Director Tom Malafronte will present information on the airport's financial, operational, capital improvement, and planning initiatives. No action is required.
items: Communication from Tom Malafronte, Airport Director, regarding Manchester-Boston Regional Airport's financial, operational, capital improvement, and planning initiatives (informational only, no action required)
plain_text:
SPECIAL COMMITTEE ON AIRPORT ACTIVITIES 
October 20, 2026 at 4:45 PM 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Members: Aldermen Burkush, Sapienza, Barry, Dexter, Terrio 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. Communication from Tom Malafronte, Airport Director, regarding Manchester-
Boston Regional Airport's financial, operational, capital improvement, and 
planning initiatives. 
(Note: Provided for informational purposes only; no action is required.) 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
